Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Set a unit and color scheme using standard options
- Added warning and critical thresholds for conditional coloring
- Configured the legend as a table with calculated values
- Inspected raw panel data and query performance
